inference_kind: deterministic forward passes for exact finite-support probabilities; no token generation
purpose: Diagnose why the completed Sprint XIII online-actor campaigns showed unchanged sampled trusted outcomes by exactly enumerating the already-consumed finite route policy space under the retained baseline and final checkpoints.
claim_boundary: This is post-outcome analysis of consumed synthetic prompts. It is not fresh task evidence, a new training run, a coding result, or a generalization claim. It must not be reported as a new model-generated success.
hypothesis: Exact trusted expected reward and trajectory divergence can distinguish a policy-shift/sampling-sensitivity explanation from a reward/objective or representation explanation in the retained Sprint XIII campaign.
cheapest_falsification: Verify the raw archive and all input hashes, then compare the exact baseline first-step action probabilities against retained evaluation receipts before enumerating the policy tree.
primary_outcome: Exact expected trusted verifier-v1 reward per frozen synthetic task for each retained final policy, paired against its seed baseline.
secondary_outcomes: Exact probability of verifier-v1 reward 1.0 and exact task-success probability
Reward variance, trajectory entropy, policy total variation, and forward/reverse sequence KL
Expected generated-token count and first-step probability calibration
Retained Monte Carlo outcomes compared with exact policy probabilities

source.policies: All three retained seed baselines and every one of the 13 independently audited completed final case checkpoints; incomplete cases are excluded and remain listed as incomplete.

enumeration.support: four frozen single-token action IDs plus EOS
enumeration.reward_functions: The exact version-0 proxy and version-1 trusted score from scripts/sprint_xiii/online_actor.py, evaluated over every terminal policy sequence.

resource_budget.device: Apple M1 Pro, 32 GiB unified memory

stopping_rule: Abort on any input hash mismatch, protocol/source identity mismatch, unsupported checkpoint state, failed first-step calibration, or resource limit. Retain an abort receipt; do not alter limits or rerun on the same data under a changed protocol.

interpretation.sampling_uncertainty: Use the exact policy expectation as the primary diagnosis; retained sampled outcomes are descriptive and not independent task observations.
interpretation.development_exposure: All prompts and synthetic tasks were consumed in Sprint XIII and are not eligible as fresh Development or held-out tasks.
interpretation.success_claim: No coding success or task-generalization claim is authorized.
